info.name: Atlasna Catalog - Phase 1
info.description:
Phase 1 API (catalog + auth) for a local dev server.

1. `docker compose up -d` and `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (dev profile).
2. Run the whole collection (Runner) or start with **1. Auth → Login as admin**.

Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables automatically. Every request has tests that check the status and the error `code`. Safe to re-run: emails, phones and names are made unique per run.

adminEmail / adminPassword are the local dev values from application-dev.yml - never real credentials.
